description:
Workforce Manager for Gov is a fully-integrated platform, which facilitates the business needs of a agency with mobile employees. On top of robust features such as Wireless Forms, Timekeeping, Job Dispatching, and GPS Tracking, customers with vehicles can leverage the solution’s fleet components to monitor vehicle activities like stop times, idling, driver behavior, score cards, and telematics. 

This intuitive, yet flexible solution addresses key market challenges such as ease of use, data collection, mobile resource management, implementation costs, and worker compliance and overall accountability. The synergy of tools in Workforce Manager for Gov brings agencies greater efficiency and productivity gains by automating and streamlining processes that help them save time, reduce labor costs, and lower vehicle-related expenses such as fuel and maintenance. Agencies benefit from an easily deployable solution that provides a significant return on investment.

Workforce Manager for Gov is equipped with enterprise-grade workforce management tools that are typically only found in high-priced business applications, making it affordable and accessible to all Government Agencies. This approach provides customers with a solution that delivers relevant information about daily field operations, helping agencies craft new business strategies to save both time and money.

description:
CobbleStone Contract Insight contract management software is delivered as SaaS offering using a multi-tenant public cloud computing environment. It is available to federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, government contractors, education systems, and more. CobbleStone contract lifecycle management software (CLM) increases efficiency and security with a web-enabled solution that helps users:

* Simplify and enhance the entire contract lifecycle
* Conduct advanced searching and reporting
* Complete tasks and achieve goals with email and calendar alerts for key dates
* Track financials to control spend
* Increase agreement collaboration and visibility
* Improve contract cycle times with automated workflow and electronic signatures
* Contract writing with pre-approved templates and clauses
* Artificial intelligence (AI) data extraction and negotiation with playbooks redlining
* Run advanced reports
* And much more

product: Gordian Federal Cloud powered by RSMeans Data
description:
Gordian Federal Cloud is an enterprise Software as a Service (SaaS) solution powered by RSMeans data. The cloud-based solution is a comprehensive suite of modules designed to securely provide federal users with the tools and cost data to better manage construction and facilities estimates, contracts and pricing proposals. Decision-makers are empowered with up-to-date information that will deliver accurate and competitive bids, minimize the risk of cost overruns, reduce variability and gain control over costs.

Gordian is the leader in facility and construction cost data, software and services for all phases of the building lifecycle. A pioneer of Job Order Contracting, Gordian’s solutions also include our proprietary RSMeans data and a comprehensive suite of Facilities Planning solutions. From planning to design, procurement, construction and operations, Gordian’s solutions help clients maximize efficiency, optimize cost savings and increase building quality.

description: LCPtracker Pro is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Public Cloud cloud computing environment. It is available to public commercial enterprises, federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, and government contractors. LCPtracker Pro is a cloud-based prevailing wage and workforce compliance management solution. The application is ideal for public agencies and prime contractors that are responsible for keeping all contractors on their project, even down to the lower-tier subcontractors, compliant. Additionally, clients can track detailed worker information and leverage dynamic reporting to monitor workforce initiatives.
